response.sql: WITH type_counts AS (SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders AS o WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM riskandmargin AS r WHERE r.ordervault = o.recordvault) GROUP BY o.ordertune), counts_with_average AS (SELECT order_count, AVG(order_count) OVER () AS overall_average FROM type_counts) SELECT AVG(order_count) AS average_count, AVG(order_count - overall_average) AS average_excess FROM counts_with_average WHERE order_count > overall_average
